entities.name: Akira Mutō
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Akira Mutō   was a general in the Imperial Japanese Army during World War II. He was convicted of war crimes and was executed by hanging. Mutō was implicated in both the Nanjing Massacre and the Manila massacre.
